name: filter_lpqi_650_1nm
label: LPQI 1 nm filter, 650 nm red continuum beside H-alpha (650 nm)
sources: PROPOSED here (2026-10-08), not in F. Prada's confirmed set: a 1 nm red continuum filter 6 nm blueward of H-alpha, for binaries whose hot primaries have winds or line emission (iota Ori) -- keeps the red filter's advantages (least-resolved disks, best fringe contrast, 35 ps MPD) without sitting in the line.
notes: Same width and throughput as the confirmed LPQI filters; 650.0 nm avoids H-alpha (656.3), C II 657.8/658.3 and He I 667.8.
Throughput 0.9 = FILTER_THROUGHPUT (filter + relay optics); the telescope file carries the rest.
assumptions: the filter itself (proposed, to be discussed with the LPQI team)
